$comment: The first half of Meta's publishing flow. POST /{ig-user-id}/media creates a container and returns its id; it does not publish media.
title: Instagram media container
description: Create an Instagram image container. This reports success before any post exists: pass its id to Publish Instagram media, or the unpublished container expires after 24 hours without producing a post.
$idempotencyComment: Meta documents no idempotency key. Retrying creates a second container, and neither becomes a post until a separate publish call succeeds.

config.label: Instagram user ID
config.description: The professional Instagram account's numeric Graph API id.

config.label: Image URL
config.description: A publicly reachable image URL. Meta fetches its bytes while creating the container.

config.label: Caption
config.description: The caption stored with the container and used when published.

outputShape.description: The creation id to pass to Publish Instagram media.
